headline: Swastika Infra wins Rs 615.76 crore MSEDCL contract
hook: Major infrastructure order secured from MSEDCL
summary: Swastika Infra Limited has secured a single order worth Rs 615.76 crore from the Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL). The announcement was formally communicated to the NSE on October 7, 2026. This contract represents a significant project win for the infrastructure firm. Retail investors should note the impact of this large-scale order on the company's future revenue pipeline.
why_it_matters: Significant revenue boost for the company's order book.
